name: foundry-connect-channel
description: Optional companion to the foundry-connect plugin: a local Claude Code channel that links a terminal session to the Foundry Connect chat drawer, so messages typed in the web app reach this session. Includes the /foundry-channel-login command.

instance_host.title: Foundry Connect instance hostname
instance_host.description: Your Foundry Connect HOSTNAME ONLY, e.g. foundry.your-org.edu. Do not include https://, do not include a trailing slash, and do not include /mcp. Use the same hostname you gave the foundry-connect plugin.
